images.scene: Robinson stows provisions into the lockers of his small boat drawn up on the beach: stacked round barley loaves, an earthen pot of rice, a small bottle, half a goat carcass, and two rolled watch-coats packed at the ends of the hull.
images.alt: A man loads bread, a pot, and supplies into his small boat before setting out to sea.

images.scene: Robinson stands on a rocky hilltop with his gun in hand, gazing down at a fierce sea current sweeping past a long ledge of rocks that juts far out from the point into the ocean below.
images.alt: A man stands on a hill with his gun, looking down at a strong current running past rocks.

images.scene: Robinson heaves a huge tortoise, almost as big as he can lift, over the side into his small boat on the shore, a large earthen water jar already stowed inside.
images.alt: A man lifts a large tortoise into his boat beside a big water jar.

images.scene: Robinson stands in his small boat far out on the open sea, arms stretched longingly toward the small distant island shrinking on the horizon behind him.
images.alt: A man in a boat far out at sea reaches his arms toward the distant shrinking island.

images.scene: Robinson peers down into an earthen pit where a large fierce old he-goat is trapped, the broken hurdle cover pushed aside, with three young kids caught in nearby pits.
images.alt: A man looks down into a pit trap holding a big he-goat, with kids in other pits nearby.

images.scene: Robinson sits on a low stool milking a tame goat into a wooden pail inside his fenced enclosure, other goats and kids grazing around him.
images.alt: A man sits milking a tame goat into a pail while others graze in the pen.
